facts.fact: IMIJ's project page says the SNIAC national system is operational and provides digital authentication and certification services alongside issuing the national ID card and e-passport.
facts.system: Sistema Nacional de Identificação e Autenticação Civil (SNIAC)

systems.country_label: Sistema Nacional de Identificação e Autenticação Civil

CPV.note: The page names no link between the civil register and the ID system.
It counts cards issued (215,189 ID cards), not people enrolled or a share of the population.
Nothing stated about a number at birth.
Lists the entities involved but does not say who operates, maintains or owns the system.
No register keyed on the ID number is named.

facts.fact: IMIJ's project page says the SNIAC national identification system is operational and issues the national ID card (215,189 issued by Q2 2021), the e-passport and the foreign residents' permit.
facts.system: Sistema Nacional de Identificação e Autenticação Civil (SNIAC)

CPV.note: NOSI is listed as an involved entity but the page does not say what it or government staff do.
Police named only as an involved entity; no station records stated.
